t: A low-cost FPGA board with an HDMI port for learning digital chip design.
steps: Buy the Tang Nano 9K from the Sipeed AliExpress store or a reseller on Amazon.
Get a USB-C cable to connect it to your computer.
Install OSS-CAD-Suite, which bundles Yosys, nextpnr, Apicula and openFPGALoader.
Add the Lushay Code extension to VS Code for a one-click build button.
On Windows, use Zadig to swap the driver for JTAG Interface 0 only.
Build the LED blink example from the official TangNano-9K-example repo.
Upload it and watch the LEDs. They are active low and may look inverted.
Follow the Lushay Labs tutorial series to try the serial and screen examples next.
